root_cause: The unCheckAllInputsExcept method selects checkboxes by name attribute instead of the exclusive group attribute, so clicking the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox does not uncheck other symptom checkboxes.
repair_strategy: Update unCheckAllInputsExcept to select inputs by data-checkbox-exclusive-group when present, falling back to name attribute, ensuring the exclusive checkbox clears other options in the same group.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now clear previously ticked symptoms when selecting the exclusive 'No symptoms' option, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Possible regression for checkboxes that rely on the previous name‑based selection when no exclusive group is defined; the fallback preserves existing behavior.
verification_requirements: After the fix, selecting 'No symptoms' after ticking cough and fever results in symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being unset.
Selecting a symptom after 'No symptoms' should clear the 'No symptoms' checkbox (existing behavior).
Mouse interaction with the exclusive checkbox continues to work.
Non‑exclusive checkboxes retain their mutual‑exclusion behavior.
